answer_1.quote: We aim at generating full-length sonnets that are logically and aesthetically coherent, without training on poetic texts.

answer_2.quote: We propose to evaluate the generated poems in two novel aspects: format and novelty.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 6 professionals that hold a bachelor's degree in English literature or related majors as domain experts to annotate the generated sonnets.
answer_4.guideline: We ask them to evaluate the each poem on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very) on the following criteria: 1) Discourse Coherence, 2) Originality/Creativity, 3) Poetic in language, 4) Emotion Evoking. At last, we ask the annotators to judge if the sonnet is written by a poet with serious goals to write a poem.
